desc:
Will you solve the crime scene?!

Detective Duck is a unique puzzle game similiar to an escape room, where you will find yourself in different maps. Your ultimate goal is to find the criminal! 

🎮Play solo or with a group of up to 5 players!
📱This game is suitable for mobile players!

Private servers support up to 10 player groups!

❗Join the group for updates and sneak peeks!

Make sure to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ if you enjoyed, this greatly supports development! Thank you!
turn on notifications so you will know when new rooms will be released :)
